name: SRv6-Migration-MOP
description: Master MOP for MPLS -> SRv6 migration. Runs the deck/Confluence phases (enable IPv6 -> ISISv6/SRv6 locators -> RRv6 peers -> RRv6 policy LocPref 50 (dual plane) -> per-VRF L3VPN SRv6 -> EVPN-VPWS L2VPN SRv6 (Phase 5b) -> LocPref 150 cutover -> remove MPLS). Every phase does pre-check -> action -> post-check via the reusable 'validateChecks' subflow, a switch gate that HALTS on any failed check, and an operator approval callback (approve-phaseN event) before advancing. Phase 5b migrates the EVPN-VPWS service (vpn-129) via the l2vpn-migrate-template golden config (vpws-seamless-integration + EVI SRv6 locator). Phase 6 auto-rolls-back (LocPref 50) if the cutover post-check fails. Targets remapped for cw-dcloud-v5 (RRv6=pce-11 2011::11, PEs node-2/node-4, L3VPN vpn-101, L2VPN vpn-129). Full editable check set lives in checks-srv6-migration.json.

name: runSingleCheck
description: Runs ONE check for validateChecks. Input: { check: {name,node,command,expect,phase,nedExec?} }. ${ ( .postResult // .preResult // {} ) as $r | { WEBEX_ROOM_ID: .WEBEX_ROOM_ID, WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN: .WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, _phase: ( .notifyPhase // $r.phase // "SRv6 Migration" ), _status: ( .notifyStatus // ( if ($r.allPass == true) then "PASS" elif ($r.allPass == false) then "FAILED" else "INFO" end ) ), _total: ( ( $r.results // [] ) | length ), _passed: ( ( $r.passed // [] ) | length ), _failedList: ( ( $r.failed // [] ) | map( .name + "@" + .node ) | join(", ") ) } | . + { webexBody: { markdown: ( "**SRv6 Migration — " + ._phase + "**  

Status: **" + ._status + "**  
Checks: " + ( ._passed | tostring ) + "/" + ( ._total | tostring ) + " PASS" + ( if ( ._failedList | length ) > 0 then "  
❌ FAILED: " + ._failedList else "" end ) + "  
" ), roomId: .WEBEX_ROOM_ID } } }

definition.description: Secure, migration-aware Webex notifier. Reads WEBEX_ROOM_ID and WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN from the workflow's runtime input/state (NOT hardcoded — supply via a CWM secret/input or the 'webex' resource). Auto-summarizes the latest pre/post check result already in state (.postResult or .preResult): phase, PASS count / total, and the failed-check list (name@node). Callers may override the headline via .notifyPhase and .notifyStatus.

stateDataFilter.output: ${ { out: .rawOutput } }

${ { name: .check.name, node: .check.node, command: .check.command, expect: .check.expect, phase: .check.phase, output: .rawOutput } | . + { verdict: ( .expect as $exp | if ( (.output // "") | test($exp) ) then "PASS" else "FAIL" end ) } | ( if .verdict == "PASS" then . else ("ASSERT verdict=" + (.verdict|tostring)) | error end ) }

${ { name: .check.name, node: .check.node, expect: .check.expect, output: .rawOutput } | . + { verdict: ( .expect as $e | if ( (.output // "") | test($e) ) then "PASS" else "FAIL" end ) } | ( if .verdict == "PASS" then . else ("FAIL " + .node + "/" + .name) | error end ) }
${ { verdict: ( (.rawOutput // "") | test(.check.expect) ) } | ( if .verdict then . else error("verdict-fail") end ) }
